title: VA Healthcare and Disability Benefits in Plain English
bigPicture: VA health care and disability money can help seniors stay healthy and safe.
whatYouNeedToKnow: You can get free or low‑cost doctor visits, medicine, and hospital care if you served in the military.
If a service injury or illness makes it hard to work, you may get monthly money called disability benefits.
You can apply for both at the same time, and you do not need a lawyer to start.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Waiting too long to apply and losing back pay.
Thinking you have to quit your job to qualify for help.
actionSteps: Gather your service papers, medical records, and any proof of disability.
Go to the VA website or call the VA helpline to start your application.
